summary: Recent updates to the 2D graphics library in Firefox focus on improving performance and stability for graphics rendering tasks. This includes removing outdated code related to MacOSurface creation, which simplifies the graphics processing pipeline. Additionally, adjustments have been made to ensure that software filters work more efficiently by clamping float parameters and recalculating the range of convolve filters in the integer domain. Notably, Firefox now supports **biplanar IOSurface formats for 8-bit 4:2:2 video**, enhancing the compatibility and quality of video displays. These changes not only streamline graphics handling but also support better video rendering experiences.
